name: Add GET /users/{id} Endpoint
description: The FastAPI application in `app.py` already has a `GET /users` endpoint but is missing `GET /users/{user_id}`. Add this endpoint. It must return the user object for a valid ID, return HTTP 404 when the user does not exist, and FastAPI should handle type validation (invalid non-integer IDs return 422).
visible_hint: GET /users/1 should return Alice's user object with status 200
